set.body: The current court proves fixed-support local analyses only. Add a coordinate fixture whose sphere/radius and boundary semantics can be instantiated by PyMVPA's native sphere_searchlight and ScalaFIM's voxel or surface frame builder. Compare ordered center/support identity, local failures, outputs, and setup/kernel performance. Do not add a PyMVPA compatibility layer.
set.title: Certify native searchlight neighborhood semantics against PyMVPA
